minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved a flow-increase for a new Massachusetts Ave gym and advanced ADU connection fees
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Sewer Commission approved a sewer use/flow increase for a new Empire Athletics fitness facility opening at 308 Massachusetts Ave, and continued work on proposed sewer connection fees and regulations for accessory dwelling units (ADUs), which will need town counsel review and a town meeting vote. The commission also approved its prior minutes, heard a routine update on first-quarter FY26 sewer demand billing, and noted upcoming public hearings on easement waiver requests.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission approved a flow-increase for a new fitness facility at 308 Massachusetts Ave, replacing a lower-use tenant.
Commissioners kept working on connection fees and regulations for accessory dwelling units, still short of a final vote.
The ADU rules still need town counsel review, then a town meeting vote, likely at the November annual meeting.
A commissioner will step out of part of the October 14 meeting covering an easement waiver at a property he is personally involved with.

why_it_matters: The flow-increase vote is what lets a business change, like a new gym, connect to town sewer at its actual level of use.
The ADU connection fee, once it clears town counsel and a town meeting vote, would set what a homeowner pays to add sewer service for an accessory dwelling.
The recusal keeps a commissioner from voting on a matter involving his own property, a routine conflict-of-interest step ahead of that hearing.
